verdict.rationale: Signifyd is a fraud-prevention platform; evidence covers API endpoints, webhooks, and a sensitive-data protection layer, but there is no mention of AI model training, opt-out controls, or data-usage policies for AI training. Absence of evidence for an applicable privacy-posture claim yields none. missing for 10: explicit AI-training opt-out policy, statement on model training data usage, user-facing controls to restrict data use for AI training.
